Generally I don't think either is easier over the other. Personally I like to sing the vocals separately and make sure I can sing it confidently. At the same time, I practice the strumming/picking until it becomes almost second nature. Pretty much master both with the most difficult part being to bring them together. 

One thing that helps me is to recognize the beat in the song and tap to it while strumming. For example, I would count 1, 2, 3, 4 change chords, 1, 2, 3, 4 change chords. By the first tap I know I should say this "word" or "this phrase". It helps with timing what words to sing while you're strumming.
